typography.rules: Avoid generic Inter for titles. Use bold weight for headings with tight letter spacing (-0.02em). Maintain 1.6+ line-height for body text for optimal readability by senior users.

colors.theme_preference: Light theme default with high contrast support & seamless dark mode toggle
colors.contrast_rules: Text against light background must exceed 5:1 contrast ratio. Primary action buttons must feature bold white text on high-contrast emerald or deep blue. Warning banners use distinct color coding (Green = Safe, Amber = Caution, Red = High Risk).

layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-2xl for cards and buttons, rounded-xl for input fields
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 lg:gap-8

hero.headline: Stop Tech Support Scammers Before They Take Control
hero.subheadline: Simple Scam Protection blocks suspicious remote access tools (AnyDesk, TeamViewer), alerts on scam command execution, and verifies dangerous links in real time.
hero.trust_badge: 100% Free • Open Source Python • No Registration Required

live_link_checker.title: Instant Scam Link & Message Analyzer
live_link_checker.description: Paste any suspicious SMS, email, or URL below to verify if it is safe.
live_link_checker.placeholder: e.g., 'Your PC has 5 viruses! Call Microsoft support at 1-800-555-0199 or click http://support-microsoft-alert-fix.cc'
verdict_card_states: Safe (Green): verified legitimate URL structure, no scam triggers
Suspicious (Amber): impersonation indicators, newly registered domain, urgent call-to-action language
Dangerous (Red): known malware domain, remote-access payload link, fake toll-free scam number

features_grid.title: Remote Access Blocker
features_grid.description: Detects unauthorized background launches of AnyDesk, TeamViewer, RustDesk, and UltraViewer.

features_grid.title: Fake Alert & Command Shield
features_grid.description: Monitors suspicious PowerShell, CMD, or browser full-screen scam tricks before scammers gain access.

features_grid.title: Real-Time System Tray Protection
features_grid.description: Runs quietly in your Windows tray with clear desktop pop-up alerts in plain English.

features_grid.title: Live Link & Phone Number Checker
features_grid.description: Analyzes suspicious links and fake toll-free numbers using heuristic scam databases.

features_grid.title: Detailed Local Activity Log
features_grid.description: Keep complete records of intercepted attempts on your PC without sharing private data.

features_grid.title: Family Guard Mode
features_grid.description: Allows caretakers to inspect logs and set one-click blocking rules for non-technical family members.

interactive_components.link_checker: Must include instant rule-based parsing with visual badges, category tags, clear explanations, and copyable share results.
interactive_components.building_simulator: Step-by-step interactive tabs for Installation (ZIP extract -> run build script -> system tray launch).
interactive_components.scam_alert_preview: Interactive preview tool showing how a pop-up alert looks when a scammer tries to launch AnyDesk or fake CMD commands.

data_testid_convention.rule: All interactive buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and output cards MUST contain clear kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the landing page in React with Tailwind CSS, supporting both Light and Dark modes seamlessly.
Use Phosphor or Lucide icons for rich security indicators (ShieldCheck, AlertTriangle, Lock, Terminal, Monitor, UserCheck).
Ensure the Live Link Checker has a comprehensive set of predefined sample scam messages and URLs so users can quickly test one-click presets.
Provide downloadable mock ZIP contents (or client-side text generation/download blob) for 'SimpleScamProtection_v1.2.zip'.
Include an interactive alert simulator allowing users to see how the system tray notification responds to scam attempts.
Strictly follow contrast and large readable typography standards for accessibility.
